metadata.title: AudioVerse — Listen. Learn. Imagine.
metadata.description: Thousands of stories. One beautiful listening experience. Discover audiobooks, podcasts, and more with AudioVerse.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AudioVerse
faq.a1: Yes! AudioVerse offers a free tier with access to thousands of audiobooks. We also offer a premium subscription for unlimited access to our entire library.
faq.a2: Absolutely. You can download any audiobook to your device and listen without an internet connection. Perfect for commutes, flights, and travel.
faq.q3: Does it work on both iPhone and Android?
faq.a3: AudioVerse is currently available on Android via Google Play. Our iOS app is coming soon to the App Store.
faq.a4: When you sign in with your Google account, your listening progress, bookmarks, and favorites automatically sync across all your devices in real-time.
faq.a5: Yes, our player supports speed adjustments from 0.5x to 3x, so you can listen at your perfect pace.
faq.a6: We offer Fiction, Non-Fiction, Self-Help, Business, Science, History, Biography, Fantasy, Mystery, Romance, and many more genres.

By using AudioVerse, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

intro.title: Delete Your AudioVerse Account
intro.body: We're sorry to see you go. AudioVerse allows you to delete your account directly from within the application. Before deleting your account, please read the information below to understand how the process works and what happens to your data.

howTo.title: How to Delete Your Account
howTo.intro: You can request account deletion at any time by following these steps:
howTo.outro: Once confirmed, your account will immediately enter the deletion process.

afterRequest.title: What Happens After You Request Deletion
items: You will no longer be able to use your account normally.
Your account enters a 30-day recovery period.
During these 30 days, your account and data remain securely stored but inaccessible to others.
afterRequest.outro: This recovery period allows you to change your mind if the deletion request was made accidentally.

recovering.title: Recovering Your Account
recovering.intro: If you decide to keep your account, simply sign in again within 30 days using your original login method. Restoring your account during this period will:
recovering.outro: No data will be lost if your account is restored before the recovery period ends.

permanentDeletion.title: Permanent Deletion
permanentDeletion.body: If your account is not restored within 30 days, it will be permanently deleted. This process cannot be reversed. After permanent deletion, your personal information, profile, favorites, listening history, and associated account data will be removed from our systems, except where retention is required by applicable law.

dataDeleted.intro: When permanent deletion is completed, the following information is removed:

dataRetained.intro: Certain limited information may be retained when required to:
dataRetained.outro: Any retained information will be stored only for as long as required by applicable law.
